## 1.0.0 (2026-11-05)

### ✨ New Features

* bypass restriction, unlock vip  & disable telemetry ([50ee755](https://github.com/Ikuradachi/Kagecarbit/commit/50ee7552a59910637b3e4487a59aa84f3c6ba8ef))

patches.name: Disable tracking and analytics (Experimental)
patches.description: Attempts to block background telemetry and trackers. Not guaranteed to stop 100% of data collection.

patches.name: Enable browser
patches.description: Shows the browser in the projected mirror grid for non-SDK mode.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Uses Morphe GmsCore for Google sign-in and sign-out.

patches.name: Unlock VIP features
patches.description: Enables Mapbox, Google Maps, Spotify integration, and TwinSpace features.
